# KELLY CODE

URL:
https://kellycode.us/

Title:
KELLY CODE — The Theory of Identity Survival

Author:
Nicholas Van-Orton

Contact:
contact@nexarium.us

Last Updated:
2026-07-04

Summary:
The Kelly Code proposes the Theory of Identity Survival, examining how identities remain recognizable across changing environments, roles, media, institutions, and historical systems.

- Identity Theory
- Visual Culture
- Art History
- Cultural Studies
- Philosophy
- Pattern Recognition
- Attention
- Identity Portability
- Autonomous Identity
